body:
WHAT
`npm run dist:linux` bundles the engine with the Linux ripgrep binary and runs electron-builder for x64 AppImage, tar.gz and deb, named MAGENTRA-<version>-linux-<arch>.<ext> (x86_64 for AppImage, amd64 for deb, x64 for tar.gz). The bundled rg is required — the bundle step fails if it is missing for a target OS.

WHY
A Linux package without ripgrep ships a broken Grep tool, and wrong artifact names break the updater's download links.

WHERE
app/package.json — scripts.dist:linux, build.linux.target ([AppImage, tar.gz, deb] each arch x64), build.linux.artifactName "MAGENTRA-${version}-linux-${arch}.${ext}", build.linux.extraResources filter including "rg", executableName "magentra". app/scripts/dist.js — spawnSync("electron-builder", ["--publish", "never", ...argv, -c.electronVersion, -c.extraMetadata.magentraCommit]). app/scripts/bundle-engine.js — RIPGREP entry { target: "linux", src: node_modules/@vscode/ripgrep-linux-x64/bin/rg }, parseTargets(), the throw when a --target OS lacks rg. .github/workflows/release.yml — linux matrix leg uploads app/dist/*.AppImage, *.tar.gz, *.deb and latest-linux.yml. app/main/updates.js — LINUX_ARCH mirrors the ${arch} renaming.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. package.json build.linux.target lists exactly AppImage, tar.gz and deb, each with arch ['x64'], and artifactName is 'MAGENTRA-${version}-linux-${arch}.${ext}'.
2. Running bundle-engine.js with --target linux when node_modules/@vscode/ripgrep-linux-x64/bin/rg is absent exits nonzero with a message refusing to package a broken Grep tool; without --target linux it only warns.
3. After a successful bundle, build-resources/engine contains engine.cjs, doc-extract.mjs, tui.mjs and an executable (0755) rg, and build.linux.extraResources.filter includes each of those names.
4. dist.js always passes '--publish never' before user argv so CI does not trigger implicit GitHub publishing, and passes -c.electronVersion equal to the installed electron version.
5. The release workflow's linux upload glob matches the three artifact extensions plus latest-linux.yml, consistent with updates.js assetName producing MAGENTRA-<v>-linux-x86_64.AppImage, -amd64.deb and -x64.tar.gz.
